item.summary: Ana Kasparian detailed her clash with Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez, arguing the congresswoman responded with “Trump-like" rhetoric after criticism over Israel funding and past House votes.

item.title: Cuba releases 2,000 prisoners amid Trump pressure, energy crisis

item.title: Common drinking habit may quietly triple risk of advanced liver condition
item.summary: Even occasional binge drinking could triple the risk of advanced liver fibrosis, a new USC study suggests, highlighting the danger of alcohol consumption patterns.

item.title: Former Syracuse basketball player to be deported after spending weeks in ICE custody
